message: An aspect suppressed the diagnostic '{0}' on '{1}', but this suppression is not yet registered in the current IDE session due to an IDE limitation. Restart your IDE to apply the suppression.
title: A diagnostic suppression defined by an aspect is not yet registered in the IDE.
rationale: The report site in TheDiagnosticAnalyzer.AnalyzeSemanticModel checks whether the suppression of '{0}' is missing from SupportedSuppressionDescriptors, not whether the diagnostic '{0}' is registered; the suppressed diagnostic is often a C# compiler warning, which is always registered. The message and the title therefore state the wrong thing as unregistered.
